lines.speaker: 아세스
lines.text: You look a little lost, as though you're not sure where to go or what to do first.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's right. I'm not sure where I should go.

lines.speaker: 아세스
lines.text: I see. Then you've met me at just the right time!

lines.speaker: 아세스
lines.text: I'm Ases, an instructor with the Adventurer Association. We help adventurers like you on their journeys.

lines.speaker: 아세스
lines.text: Now, how can I help...? Ah, follow me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? Just like that...?

lines.speaker: 아세스
lines.text: Before you set off, I think you should get some hunting practice.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That makes sense... But where are we going?

lines.speaker: 아세스
lines.text: There's a Forest Area near Belos. I help new adventurers practice hunting there.

lines.speaker: 아세스
lines.text: Even people who know their way around a fight can get flustered when they actually head out.

lines.speaker: 아세스
lines.text: I'll go ahead and wait for you. Gather what you need, then come when you're ready.

lines.speaker: 아세스
lines.text: You'll find the path to the Forest Area farther into the village. It shouldn't be hard to find.

steps.name: The Flower Girl
steps.objective: Talk to [Ases] in the "Forest Area", then enter the mysterious place in the "Ancient Forest".

lines.speaker: 아세스
lines.text: Did you have any trouble getting here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm fine, Instructor.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I'm getting a strange feeling from over there...)

lines.speaker: 아세스
lines.text: Curious about that place? That's the Ancient Forest, a woodland of very old trees. You'll have to pass through it to get to Elias.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A forest of ancient trees...)

lines.speaker: 아세스
lines.text: I watched you on the way here. You're better than I expected—good enough that you hardly need any more instruction from me.

lines.speaker: 아세스
lines.text: With your skills, you could leave this place and head elsewhere right away.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. That's kind of you to say.

lines.speaker: 아세스
lines.text: You're welcome. You can head straight to Elias, or stay here and train a little longer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I'll take a look around, then head to the Ancient Forest.

lines.speaker: 아세스
lines.text: Something's come up, so I'm going to the Temple of Pluton.

lines.speaker: 아세스
lines.text: Perhaps we'll run into each other again on your way to Elias.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It was nice meeting you.

lines.speaker: 아세스
lines.text: It was a pleasure, Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (So that's the Ancient Forest. I'll rest for a moment, then head over.)
(Deep inside the Ancient Forest, a strange sensation washes over %s. Something beyond words...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (There's a strange feeling coming from over there...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: According to the sign, this isn't the way to the Temple of Pluton...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll try going that way first.
(An enormous, ancient tree catches your eye. Beneath it lies a scroll with a peculiar air about it.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It feels like that scroll is calling to me... What could it be?)

(Your hand reaches for the scroll almost of its own accord. You carefully pick it up and unroll it. An ink painting depicts a beautiful valley filled with flowers, its light washes of color both delicate and bright.)
(It is only a painting, yet another world seems to stretch out beyond the scroll.)
(A girl stands in a beautiful field of flowers, gazing at a waterfall. The sight is striking.)
(Something about the girl in the painting feels strange. It is almost as if she is moving... Then you hear her voice, as though she is speaking to you.)
Iris? Iris?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh...!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What's happening? It sounds like it's inside my head. W-wait...)
(A tremendous light bursts from the scroll. Blinded by its brilliance, you let the scroll slip from your hands.)
Hey, come on! I told you not to drop the scroll like that. Oh, lovely weather today!
(The girl from the painting appears before you, chattering to herself.)
Ta-da! Zoe's here! Happy to see me? It's been ages... Huh...? Aaaah!
(The girl looks your way and recoils in surprise. Once she has calmed down, she approaches cautiously and speaks.)
Sorry about that! I thought you were someone I knew. But Muwen... Is Muwen not here? He isn't...?
Why am I here...?

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: So who are you? Oh, where are my manners? I'm Zoe. The name's Zoe!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I'm %s...

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: %s, %s... That's an unusual name. How did you end up here? Get lost?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, that's not it.

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Ah, never mind. I may be much older than you, but there's no need to be so formal. Now, how did you say you got here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You explain that you felt someone calling you and followed the feeling all the way here.)

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Someone called you? Oh, come on. You wouldn't wander all the way out here just for that. You must've gotten lost. Unless...

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Well, never mind. But what am I doing here?

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: (Zoe looks utterly baffled.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Um, there's something I'd like to ask...

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: All right. What's on your mind?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What should I ask?)

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: I'm Zoe! Like I said, just your ordinary flower spirit. Do I need another introduction? Never seen a flower spirit before?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A spirit? You're a spirit...? No, this is my first time.

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Huh? You've really never seen one?

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: What a strange person you are, never having seen a spirit... All right, I'll explain, so listen up.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Everything in nature has a spirit. Powerful spirits can take physical form, like me. And pretty spirits show up looking as lovely as I do!

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: (Zoe steals a glance at you.)

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: What, have people been lying to you your whole life? Try believing someone for once!

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: How rude! You're speaking to a beautiful spirit, as radiant as peonies and roses! Hmph!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I didn't say anything...

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Fine, fine! My mistake! Some spirits are blue-skinned, muscular men with bushy beards—or old fellows, for that matter... (mumble, mumble)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But why were you in the scroll?

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Ah, well. A long time ago, I made a contract with the owner of this scroll...

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: I can't tell you what's in the contract. Maybe you'll find out someday, if the chance comes. The rest is a secret. A secret!

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Whew...

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Who's Muwen? Hmm. That boy... Well, Muwen's my traveling companion, and I'm his guardian.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A boy?

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: That's right. He's still a young lad. Though sometimes he's surprisingly grown-up.

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: When we first set out with Iris, he was an ordinary boy who loved playing pranks. Now he's grown into a fine adventurer.

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: His talent for adventure and that pure heart of his... He must get those from his parents, Zenon and Gowen...
(Zoe looks both pleased and proud.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You really care about Muwen, don't you?

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: That boy can't do a thing without me. I don't know whether he's foolish or just innocent. He drives me up the wall!

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: %s, are you sure you haven't seen Muwen? Maybe he went to the village...

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Come to think of it, how did I mistake you for Iris, %s...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Iris...)

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: I'm not sure, but I felt some mysterious power from you. A little like Iris... Such strong determination, with a hint of loneliness...

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Never mind that. You! I get the feeling you've met Iris before. Am I imagining it? But Iris is definitely... Oh, no. Forget I said anything.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You tell Zoe what you know about Iris.)

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Huh...?

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: ...Then I suppose you're no ordinary traveler.

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: What's that? No more questions? All right, then.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you thinking about so hard?

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Nothing. You know, there's more mystery to you than meets the eye.

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Maybe you started this journey so you could meet Iris. Whether that's chance or fate, I couldn't say...

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: As one of Iris's dear friends, there's something I have to say.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Thank you, truly... Oh, that's not it. I have a favor to ask.

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Would you let me come along on your journey?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why with me?

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: I need to find Muwen, but I've only just come out of the scroll. I'm still feeling a bit out of sorts.

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Take me along, and I can tell you more about Iris.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right! I'd like to hear more about Iris.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It might be nice to travel together until we find this boy Muwen she mentioned...)

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Hehe! Then I'm counting on you!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And I'm counting on you. Let's head to Elias.

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Oh, Elias! Sounds good to me. I've got a great sense of direction, so follow along. We might run into Muwen on the way!
(You set off for Elias with Zoe.)

steps.name: Tyr's Bow (1)
steps.objective: Meet and talk to [Ases] and [Ignate] near the statue in the "Temple of Pluton", then defeat goblins to recover the lost <Serestia>.

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Wow! Lovely weather, lovely scenery! The Temple of Pluton is built on land full of good energy. What a wonderful place!

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Huh? What's that noise?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think some monsters are running this way...

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: The monsters are doing what?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: They're coming straight at us! Get out of the way!

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Oh, don't worry about them. Running around is what they do... Huh, doesn't it look like someone's chasing them? Are those...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you sure we shouldn't move? I suppose we could watch for now...
(Two people wearing Adventurer Association instructors' caps chase after the monsters. Spotting Zoe, they stop.)
Oh, Miss Zoe?

lines.speaker: 아세스
lines.text: Wow, Zoe? It is you! And %s is with you too?

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Ases! Ignate!
(The man Zoe called Ignate greets her warmly.)

lines.speaker: 이그나트
lines.text: Zoe, it's been a while. I never expected to see you here.

lines.speaker: 아세스
lines.text: Such a cute, beautiful spirit! It must be my lucky day, running into Zoe like this. Oh, where's Muwen?

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: %s, did you hear that? Cute and beautiful, that's me!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yeah, I heard.

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Ases, Ignate, what are you doing running around the Temple of Pluton? As for Muwen...

lines.speaker: 이그나트
lines.text: It's good to see you again, but this isn't really the best time to catch up.

lines.speaker: 아세스
lines.text: Sorry. We have something to take care of. We'll see you later.

lines.speaker: 아세스
lines.text: Ugh, what a mess. Come on, Ignate.

lines.speaker: 이그나트
lines.text: Hahaha. You always keep your cool, Ases. Let's go.

lines.speaker: 아세스
lines.text: Still not as well as you do.
(Ignate and Ases take off again. People who appear to be soldiers from the Kingdom of Elias follow close behind.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it something serious?

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Must be quite a problem if they've got soldiers from Elias helping them...
Whew... It is indeed, Miss Zoe.

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Oh... You're...
(Zoe brightens at the sight of a young man looking her way. He has the air of a scholar. Catching his breath, he looks down the road the soldiers took.)
(Sweaty and exhausted, he seems to have fallen behind the others.)

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Yahui! Mr. Yahui, how have you been? What brings you here? Shouldn't you be back in the village?

lines.speaker: 야휘
lines.text: Miss Zoe, it has been a while. Whew... Something terrible has happened, and I'm afraid it's my fault.

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Oh, surely... You don't mean...?

lines.speaker: 야휘
lines.text: The [Serestia] I was keeping safe has been stolen. I was careless.

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Mr. Yahui, how could you lose it? That was... Iris's...
(Zoe looks so sad that she cannot finish.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Zoe, let's hear Mr. Yahui out first.

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: All right, %s.

lines.speaker: 조에.
lines.text: Mr. Yahui, please go on.

lines.speaker: 야휘
lines.text: I believe the monsters sensed Serestia's power and followed it into the village. They attacked without warning and took it...

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Whew... That's no toy for a bunch of monsters to play with.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Just how powerful is it...?)

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Curious, are you? Serestia is a bow made by the Tyr people. It has the power to drive away darkness.

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: It's not something those foolish monsters can use however they like. If they try, there'll be trouble! Even Iris struggled with it at first, and she's a Tyr...

lines.speaker: 야휘
lines.text: Exactly. If you have a moment to spare...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course. I'll help.

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: %s, I'm sorry. Maybe you and Iris...

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Oh, never mind...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Zoe, what's wrong?

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Nothing. But now that we know, we can't just leave it be!

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Muwen, wherever you are, wait just a little longer. We'll deal with this first, then come find you. Whew...

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Oh, %s. Goblins know how to use bows, so they might have it... All right, let's brace ourselves and look.

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: And Ases should still be at the temple. If we find it, we need to let her know. Got it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yeah, got it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I have plenty of questions, but first I should recover Serestia from the goblins.)
(You find Serestia among the goblins. That was surprisingly easy.)

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: That's it! That's the one. You really are something special. Just as Iris... Oh, never mind.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (There she goes, trailing off again...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So I should ask Ases what to do next?

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Exactly. And look, there's Ases over there.

lines.speaker: 아세스
lines.text: Oh, you found Serestia! What a relief!

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Ases, should we give Serestia back to Mr. Yahui?

lines.speaker: 아세스
lines.text: Yes, Zoe, that should do it. Let's go. Oh, Ignate? You look worried. What's wrong?

lines.speaker: 이그나트
lines.text: We've got trouble! The enraged goblins have headed into the village.

lines.speaker: 아세스
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Ugh, if those goblins have gone to the village, they'll be heading for...

lines.speaker: 아세스
lines.text: Goblins always raid the inn. That's where the most food is. This time will be no different...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh no, that's serious! We'd better hurry.

lines.speaker: 아세스
lines.text: But %s, can you handle it? You've only just started your journey. Wouldn't fighting that many monsters be too much?

lines.speaker: 이그나트
lines.text: She's right. It might be better to go with the soldiers from Elias...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What should we do? Zoe, how do you think we should handle this?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Zoe, what are you thinking about?

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Nothing. Something just came to mind... Let's head to the inn first.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. Let's go!

steps.name: Tyr's Bow (2)
steps.objective: Equip <Serestia> and defeat the [Goblins] that have invaded the "Belos Tavern".

lines.speaker: 에린
lines.text: Aaaah! I'm scared!

lines.speaker: 아일린
lines.text: Erin, stop panicking! You're making me scared too!

lines.speaker: 아일린
lines.text: Huh, that goblin really is huge up close! I've heard of King Goblins. Is that because they're king-sized, royally cute, and as commanding as a king?

lines.speaker: 웰딘
lines.text: Girls, calm down. What are you talking about? Those monsters are attacking our business.

lines.speaker: 웰딘
lines.text: Keber, are you all right? You were caught completely off guard...

lines.speaker: 케베르
lines.text: Don't worry. It takes more than that to knock me down. I've still got some fight left in me.

lines.speaker: 케베르
lines.text: But for some reason, my attacks aren't hurting that monster. Is some kind of magic protecting it...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Zoe, stop for a moment. There are goblins inside...

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: What's this? Not just any goblin—a King Goblin?!

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: And it isn't an ordinary King Goblin, either. Something's affected it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, those goblins...

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: You feel it too? There's a strange power coming from them... I've got a feeling ordinary attacks won't work...

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Huh? %s! Look at your back!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? W-wait. What's that...?
(A mysterious light suddenly rises from the bag on your back. Startled, you look inside. It is coming from Serestia, the bow said to have been made by the Tyr.)

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Serestia...?

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: (Could it be...?)

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Here, %s! Catch!
(Zoe tosses Serestia to %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? This is...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: W-wait! You want me to use it?

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Stop fussing! Just equip Serestia and shoot the goblins! Got it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew... All right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I don't have much choice... Here goes.)

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: All that trouble from those little pests... It's over now.

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: The owner says thank you. There wasn't much damage in the end. Good work, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, thanks... But this bow, Serestia...

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: (Only Iris was supposed to be able to use Serestia. So why did it work in %s's hands?)

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: (I can't be sure, but perhaps %s could be... for Iris...)

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: %s, this bow seems to have gone to sleep now that its job's done. Oh, Mr. Yahui! You're here?

lines.speaker: 야휘
lines.text: Just as you said, Miss Zoe. Serestia has stopped glowing, as though it has fallen asleep.

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Right, but listen, Mr. Yahui. We settled things this time, but who's to say it won't happen again?

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: What if Iris comes back to the village and finds it gone? Think how upset she'd be...

lines.speaker: 야휘
lines.text: I am truly sorry. I won't make this mistake again. Please trust me to keep it safe.

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: All right... Whew...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Zoe, let's rest a bit, then head to Elias.

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: No, there's somewhere we need to go first. The [Dragon's Lair]...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where's that?

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Deep inside the Temple of Pluton. A very nasty dragon lives there.

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: I think the one who lives there must be controlling the monsters. That was a King Goblin, after all, not an ordinary goblin...

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Invoke! Invoke's behind this!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Invoke?

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: No, no, your pronunciation's all wrong. Say it after me. In. Voke. Invoke!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, right. Invo—anyway...

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: That's the one. The master of the Dragon's Lair, a wicked red dragon hatchling...

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Maybe we shouldn't have let it off just because it was young. We'd better go teach it a lesson.

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Are you up for it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm. If we don't go, this sort of thing will keep happening, won't it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...Serestia belongs to Iris. Why did it react to me?)

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Is this really such a hard decision?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, nah... I mean, no. I was just thinking about something...

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Having second thoughts? Worried it's dangerous? Don't worry so much. You've got me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I'm counting on you, then.

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Still, we'd better prepare properly, just in case. Got it?

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Unequip Serestia, and Mr. Yahui will take care of it. I've told him he'll have me to answer to if he lets anything happen to it again!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Got it. I'll get ready right away. Let's go to the Dragon's Lair.

steps.name: Hello, Muwen
steps.objective: Defeat [Invoke] in the "Dragon's Lair", then talk to [Muwen].

lines.speaker: 인보크
lines.text: Ghk... I-I surrender. How dare you defeat me...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I did it. Th-that was tough...)

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: You did it! You were brilliant out there! You even knocked Invoke out!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: When Iris and Muwen fought it back in the day, it was a complete disaster. A couple of greenhorns who didn't know the first thing about fighting...

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: You know Tiamat, Invoke's mother? She showed up and nearly killed us all. Kazno saved our lives.

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: (Hang on. Isn't Tiamat supposed to show up when Invoke gets beaten up? Why isn't she here? Oh, well. Better that way.)

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Invoke won't be sending monsters to wreck the village anymore. It had better not!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It won't... right?

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Anyway, I'm sensing something familiar farther inside. Shall we take a quick look? Come on!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait! Zoe, wait for me!
(As the two of you hurry deeper into the lair, Invoke cautiously opens one eye.)

lines.speaker: 인보크
lines.text: They're gone, right?

lines.speaker: 인보크
lines.text: Whew. No one's here.
(Invoke sighs and gets to its feet.)

lines.speaker: 인보크
lines.text: The conqueror of earth and sky, who brings fear and despair to all living things! The ruler of flame, whose name all praise!

lines.speaker: 인보크
lines.text: Invoke!

lines.speaker: 인보크
lines.text: Oww... I ache all over. They barged in out of nowhere, spouting who knows what. Ugh, so much for my dignity.

lines.speaker: 인보크
lines.text: I'd better tell my descendants never to mess with a flower spirit. But what was that human?

lines.speaker: 인보크
lines.text: And since when do I command monsters? Iris's bow? What were they even talking about?

lines.speaker: 인보크
lines.text: W-wait... Did I just get beaten up for something I didn't do?
(At the far end of the lair, you find a boy waiting. Recognizing Zoe, he greets her with a radiant smile.)
Hey, it's Zoe!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Oh, he seems to know her well. Is this the boy she mentioned?)

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Muwen!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Seeing how her face lit up, I think that's him.)

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Muwen! Where have you been, and what have you been doing all this time?!

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: Doe, led go... It hurts.
(Zoe has grabbed Muwen's cheeks and is stretching them.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Zoe, how about letting go before you talk?

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Oh, there I go again. Old habits. Sorry, Muwen.

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: I'm all right. I'm just glad you're safe, Zoe. So glad! So glad!

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: W-wait! H-hey!
(Grinning, Muwen takes Zoe's hands and starts spinning in circles. Zoe sighs and spins along, apparently used to this.)
(After a while, Muwen finally makes eye contact with %s.)

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: Oh! You're %s! I've heard about you!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, you know who I am?

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: %s, no need to be so formal with the boy. You have my permission!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, all right.

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Muwen! You heard about %s?

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: Yeah, Ases told me. You taught that scary King Goblin a lesson!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, well...

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Then why didn't you just stay there and wait? Why come all the way out here? It's dangerous!

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: Because I knew you'd come here, Zoe.

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Honestly... This boy hasn't an ounce of fear.

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: Well, we found each other, so it all worked out!

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Worked out, my foot! You little rascal! Tell me everything you've been doing and everywhere you've been. Understand?

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: All right, don't worry... But is it okay for %s to hear this?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't mind. Go ahead.

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: %s, sorry. I need a word with Muwen. We'll talk over there for a moment. Wait here, will you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sure. I'll wait.
(Their conversation over, Zoe and Muwen walk slowly back toward you.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Finished talking?

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Yeah. I'm going with Muwen.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh? Why?

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: I'd like to go looking for Iris too, but I don't think I should leave this place yet.

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: There's something terribly ominous here...

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: Zoe, can't you feel it?

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: It's not just the threat you feel from someone like Invoke. It's terror, like when we met the Demon King...

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Muwen, that...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Terror...)

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Where in the Dragon's Lair is it coming from?

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: %s, you said you were looking for Iris, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. I'm looking for Iris...
(Before you can finish, Zoe cuts in.)

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Listen, %s... Can we leave the search for Iris to you?

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: I'm asking you too, %s. I wanted to go looking for Iris myself, but I don't know how much help I'd be right now.

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Don't say that, Muwen. Don't you know how much help you are?

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: Thanks, Zoe. Still, when it comes to finding Iris, rather than me...
(Zoe gazes intently at %s.)

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: I think %s... I have a feeling your journey will lead you to Iris, %s.

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: That's how I feel too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can't quite explain it, but I feel like I have to follow my own path.

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: We'll handle things here in our own way. Think of it as our training.

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: And if we do that, won't we meet again someday?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Someday...
(There is something quietly reassuring about Muwen's words.)

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Then give our regards to Ignate when you reach Elias, and to Xiaowei in Yong Gyoung. Though we did see Ignate just a little while ago...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I'll keep looking for Iris. See you again.

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Thank you. And we'll definitely meet again someday.

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: Goodbye, %s.

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: Oh, gone already. I'm a little sad...

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Muwen, about finding Iris... Ah, never mind. We'll talk about that later. Now we'd better find that thing.

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: Right. Maybe it's...

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Stop worrying over nothing. You'll make Iris worry too.

lines.speaker: 무웬
lines.text: All right, Zoe. Let's go.
(After Zoe and Muwen leave, someone who has been watching from an unseen hiding place slowly emerges.)
Hmph. I've always thought that brat had good instincts. Perhaps they're the reason he's still alive...
I wonder what face our prisoner would make upon learning those brats are alive.
I'm dying to know. The agony on that clueless fool's face when the truth finally came out... It was exquisite.
Don't look at me like that.
I said, don't look at me like that!
You can't do a thing, yet you dare look at me with such contempt.
Urgh... I won't let you have your way. Get out of my head! Get out!
This can't go on. Even that thing the old geezer spoke of... All of it...
I'll erase it from this world!
Ahaha... Ahahahaha... Ahahahahahaha!

steps.name: Onward to Elias
steps.objective: Look around the streets from the monument in "Elias", then find [Ignate].

lines.text: (You follow the well-kept road into the city and find yourself among a bustling crowd.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So this is Elias...
(The city blends old-world charm with sophistication, creating an air of grandeur.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wow. So this is what it's like here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I suddenly feel strange...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No use standing around. I'd better find Instructor Ignate.

lines.speaker: 이그나트
lines.text: You're the one who was with Miss Zoe...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: 이그나트
lines.text: But why are you alone?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You explain that you met up with Zoe and Muwen, then parted ways to continue your separate journeys.)

lines.speaker: 이그나트
lines.text: I see. If you've set off again with something to do, just as you did then... Where are you headed, %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think I should go to Yong Gyoung. Zoe said she knew someone there.

lines.speaker: 이그나트
lines.text: Yong Gyoung... These days, it's a provincial city of the Kingdom of Elias, but long ago it was the heart of a great empire. It's a beautiful place, with plenty to see.

lines.speaker: 이그나트
lines.text: If you need help, look for the instructor in the city you're visiting. We in the Adventurer Association keep in touch through our own communications network to help adventurers.

lines.speaker: 이그나트
lines.text: Good luck, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. I'll head there, then.
